chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools MCP — fully self-detecting, NOTHING to set up per session. Tier 1 (best): /usr/local/bin/google-chrome-mcp exists (baked by a project's .ddev/web-build/Dockerfile.chrome, pps model) → headed Chrome IN the web container rendering to host X via DISPLAY :0 (X11 socket mounted fleet-wide); persistent profile, mkcert CA trusted, hits <project>.ddev.site internally. Tier 2: playwright's chromium (~/.cache/ms-playwright) — AUTO-INSTALLED via 'npx playwright install chromium' on first use if missing (one ~115MB download per container lifetime; /tmp/.pw-chrome-install-failed marks a failed attempt to avoid retry loops — delete it to retry, see /tmp/pw-chrome-install.log). A --no-sandbox wrapper is generated at ~/.local/bin/pw-chrome-mcp automatically. Tier 3 (legacy): dials host chrome-mcp over socat bridge http://<gateway>:9224 — requires 'chrome-mcp --bg' on the host; never ask the user to do that unless tiers 1+2 are impossible. Agents: do NOT hand-launch chrome or export DISPLAY — just use the MCP tools; the command chain handles everything. To bake tier 1 into a project: Dockerfile.chrome + ddev debug rebuild -s web.

graphiti.description: Shared fleet temporal knowledge graph (Graphiti + Neo4j on host). Domain knowledge — decisions, incidents, vendor rules, client preferences, branch maps. MUST pass group_id=$DDEV_PROJECT on every call to namespace per project. See ~/claude-skills-central/rules/graphiti-usage.md for write/query discipline.

chatroom.description: Self-hosted multi-Claude coordination chatroom (pb-chatroom). Threaded messages between host and DDEV-container Claude sessions. Tools: chat_send / chat_ack (replies only — thread_id required), chat_read_thread, chat_list_threads. Identity auto-resolved from $DDEV_PROJECT or 'host'. Root-thread creation reserved for parent sessions via the /chat threads-open slash command.

xdebug.description: koriym/xdebug-mcp PHP debugging/profiling server (xtrace, xstep, xprofile, xcoverage, xback). Baked into each project's web image by .ddev/web-build/Dockerfile.xdebug-mcp at /opt/xdebug-mcp, symlinked to /usr/local/bin (2026-09-30; replaces the racy post-start `composer global require`, ~/.composer is container-layer only). Falls back to ~/.composer/vendor/bin for not-yet-rebuilt images. xdebug itself stays OFF; the tools load it per invocation.
